paper_cards.title: LAW: Unifying Language, Action, and World Modeling for Agentic Physical Intelligence
paper_cards.data: Released RoboTwin demonstrations and VLM supervision; evaluation spans 50 simulated tasks and three long-horizon real-robot tasks.
paper_cards.method: A hybrid-expert VLM plans subtasks, scores WAM action proposals and checks progress; a mixture-of-transformer-experts WAM jointly models video and action with hierarchical memory and subtask-local value learning.
paper_cards.task: Long-horizon closed-loop robot manipulation with semantic planning, execution monitoring and recovery.
paper_cards.novelty: Integrates planning, progress assessment, value-guided action fusion and a WAM backbone in one released agent loop.
paper_cards.evidence: The official repository, pushed 2026-11-06, releases code, four checkpoints, two training datasets, pinned downloads and verification scripts.

claim_checks.claim: Code, four checkpoints and two training-data packages are publicly released.
claim_checks.notes: Official release inspected; reported results were not independently reproduced.

paper_cards.limitations: Real-robot evidence covers three tasks on one platform; full rollouts were not completed in this run.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Direct baseline and runtime interface for planning, state checks and recovery around world-action policies.

demo_cards.demo_notes: Official code, checkpoints, datasets and three real-robot highlight videos are public.
